description: Source code implementing Vault class with Netflix-specific key management, encryption, and decryption functions, including external dependencies and conditional provisioning logic.

classes.name: Vault
classes.description: Implements a secure vault for cryptographic keys and data, with support for Netflix-specific keys and conditional provisioning.

methods.name: Vault::NetflixInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the Netflix-specific Vault, initializing it with provisioning or file-based data.

methods.name: Vault::PlatformInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the platform-specific Vault.

methods.name: Vault::Vault
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Vault with a key, optional constructor, and destructor callbacks.

methods.name: Vault::~Vault
methods.description: Destructor that invokes the cleanup callback.

methods.name: Vault::Cipher
methods.description: Performs encryption or decryption using AES-128 CTR mode with optional IV handling.

methods.name: Vault::Size
methods.description: Returns the size of a stored blob, considering exportability.

methods.name: Vault::Import
methods.description: Imports data into the vault, encrypting it and assigning an ID.

methods.name: Vault::Export
methods.description: Exports data from the vault, decrypting it.

methods.name: Vault::Put
methods.description: Stores a sealed data blob and returns its ID.

methods.name: Vault::Get
methods.description: Retrieves a sealed data blob by ID.

methods.name: Vault::Generate
methods.description: Generates a random data blob and stores it.

methods.name: Vault::Delete
